title: Mexico Demands US Investigate the Death of a Mexican National in Laredo; 18 So Far in the Trump Era
author: La Redacción
content:
_This article by[La
Redacción](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/la%20redacci%C3%B3n) originally
appeared in the [October 18, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/18/politica/mexico-exige-
a-eu-investigar-la-muerte-de-un-connacional-en-laredo-van-18-en-la-era-trump),
Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. The Secretariat of Foreign Affairs (SRE) asked US authorities
for a **prompt, exhaustive and transparent investigation** to clarify the
circumstances of the death of a Mexican man at the Rio Grande Processing
Center in Laredo, Texas, and to determine, where applicable, the corresponding
responsibilities.

It reported that it was notified of the case by the local office of
Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), through the Consulate General of
Mexico in Laredo.

In a statement, it said that since it learned of the events, the consular
office activated the corresponding protection protocol, established
communication with the relatives and has provided the necessary consular
assistance.

This case **brings to 18 the number of Mexican nationals who have died in
these circumstances** since January 20, 2025 –when Donald Trump’s second
administration began–, “a situation that demands an effective response from US
authorities to guarantee the life, integrity and human rights of migrants.”

The Government of Mexico expressed its **deep concern over the recurrence of
deaths of Mexican people in custody** or in the context of immigration
operations in the United States.

The SRE has undertaken diplomatic and legal actions, including diplomatic
notes to the State Department, complaints before the competent authorities and
efforts to facilitate families’ access to legal representation. It has also
reinforced consular protection actions and the monitoring of the detention
conditions of Mexican people.

This Secretariat, it said, will continue using all the diplomatic and legal
mechanisms within its reach, including **a complaint that will be sent to the
Webb County prosecutor** to seek clarification of this case. In addition,
through the Embassy of Mexico in the United States, immigration authorities
will be asked to **guarantee Mexican consuls’ access to immigration detention
centers** , so that they can fulfill their mission of guaranteeing and
demanding health care for Mexican people.

The Government of Mexico expressed its most sincere condolences to the
national’s family and reiterates its commitment to the protection and defense
of the rights of Mexican people abroad.
